confirmedItems: The manifest SHA-256 is 07d9c07ecdf78285dab13f8e83972fc4268aad7c7cde546b2cea9e76782c5154 before and after review and matches the invocation.
All six declared artifact SHA-256 values match independently recomputed raw-byte hashes; all seven candidate files were copied byte-identically to reviewed-subject.
The Phase 4 CC-002 contract and its self-test both exit 0 when run from the repository root.
The candidate preserves a fail-closed non-deployment boundary: no Azure sign-in, what-if, deployment, runtime cloud test or route promotion is authorised.

findings.title: Canonical manifest fails the required AFF phase-hash schema
evidence: Independent Draft 2020-12 validation against .github/schemas/aff-phase-hashes.schema.json fails with 12 errors.
The manifest omits schemaVersion, caseName, artifactPrefix, phaseId, modelPlanRevision and generatedAt.
Every one of the six artifacts omits the required role property.
findings.impact: The subject is not a schema-conforming canonical Phase 4 manifest and cannot provide complete phase, model-plan or artifact-role traceability for a human gate.
findings.remediation: Preserve this bound candidate. Create a new append-only candidate manifest with all required top-level metadata and one valid AFF role for every artifact, validate it against the schema, then obtain new reviews.

findings.title: MP-08 invents a Phase 5 approval hash and targets the wrong approval path
evidence: stratton-implementation-catalogue-cc-002-proposed.json workPackages[7].phase5ApprovalGate.sha256 is 64 one characters, which is not evidence derived from a future record.
workPackages[7].phase5ApprovalGate.evidencePath is cases/Stratton-Europe-Captital/5-coding/evidence/stratton-phase-5-approval-evidence.json rather than the approval-record convention.
The required CC-002 future target is approvals/5/stratton-phase-5-cc-002-approval-1.json; no such approved record is present in this subject.
findings.impact: A fabricated-looking hash and non-canonical path can falsely satisfy or misroute a future approval dependency.
findings.remediation: Represent the pending dependency with a null/unresolved SHA-256 state, retain PENDING_BLOCKED and failClosed true, and target cases/Stratton-Europe-Captital/approvals/5/stratton-phase-5-cc-002-approval-1.json. Populate its hash only from the immutable record after approval exists.

findings.title: MP-07 does not carry the approved evaluation and security promotion contract
evidence: The approved Phase 3 evaluation contract defines blocking EVAL-001 through EVAL-010 with thresholds: 100 cases; 100% material citation; at least 95% extraction accuracy; at least 99% critical-field accuracy; zero critical unsupported claims; zero missed critical risks; at most 2% other unsupported claims; at least 90% high-risk recall; p95 below 5 seconds; and completion within 30 minutes.
Its eight route records each require primaryAndRecoveryParityRequired=true.
Evaluation, routing and security contracts contain the same 12 immutable blocking gates CC002-R2-SEC-GATE-001 through -012.
Phase 4 MP-07 records only the 100-case minimum and raw/derived retention, omitting the other nine EVAL thresholds, route parity and all 12 security gates.
findings.impact: Phase 5 could implement and report a benchmark that passes a materially weaker gate than the approved Phase 3 design.
findings.owner: AFF-4 / Model Evaluation and Validation Owner / Security Owner / AI Governance
findings.remediation: Bind MP-07 to the approved evaluation, routing and security contract hashes; encode EVAL-001..010 exactly, require primary/recovery parity for every route, require all 12 immutable security gates, and fail closed unless every applicable gate passes with retained evidence.

findings.title: All owner inputs are assigned to one technically scoped owner
evidence: All six requiredOwnerInputs records assign Accountable Azure Platform Owner, including provider data-use and EU AI Act classification evidence.

Approved Phase 3 records allocate technical deployment evidence across Azure Platform, AI Governance and Service Operations; privacy lifecycle to DPO, Data Owners and Records Owner; EU AI Act classification to General Counsel and Head of AI Governance; and source/provider-use evidence to General Counsel, Source Owners and AI Governance.
A platform owner alone cannot provide accountable legal classification, privacy disposition, provider-use terms or source-use authority.
findings.impact: The plan can treat evidence from an unauthorised role as sufficient to unblock legal, privacy, provider-use and regulatory gates.
findings.remediation: Split typed owner inputs by authority: Azure Platform with AI Governance/Service Operations for regions, quota, capacity and deployment IDs; Data/Search/AI Governance owners for embedding and chunking; DPO, General Counsel, Source Owners and AI Governance for privacy/provider/source use; and General Counsel, Head of AI Governance and Compliance as applicable for EU AI Act classification. Require all applicable approvals and remain fail closed.

findings.title: The implementation portfolio omits the approved embedding deployment
evidence: Approved Phase 3 portfolio specialistFoundation.embeddings specifies Azure OpenAI text-embedding-3-large with DataZoneStandard and primary/recovery deployment references.
Approved routeDeploymentSemantics includes CC002-R2-ROUTE-EMBEDDING for text-embedding-3-large.
Phase 4 modelDeploymentPolicy.selectedModels contains only LUNA, TERRA and SOL.
findings.impact: Phase 5 can implement a three-model portfolio that cannot satisfy the approved retrieval and embedding design.
findings.owner: AFF-4 / Azure AI Model Deployment Owner / Search Owner
findings.remediation: Add the text-embedding-3-large supporting deployment, its owner-supplied supported version, primary/recovery IDs, DataZoneStandard policy, dimensions/chunking evidence, recovery parity and fail-closed admission checks.

findings.title: Required Owner Inputs Markdown delimiter has the wrong cell count
evidence: stratton-cc-002-phase-4-amendment.md line 18 declares seven columns.
Line 19 delimiter contains six cells (seven pipe characters), while each data row contains seven cells (eight pipe characters).
findings.impact: Markdown renderers can misparse the authoritative owner-input table and break Markdown/HTML parity.
findings.remediation: In a new append-only candidate, use seven delimiter cells and regenerate the HTML from the corrected authoritative Markdown.

findings.title: Relative validation commands omit the required Phase 5 working directory and path guards
evidence: MP-01 through MP-07 use relative .\tests or .\app paths, but their files are explicitly under cases/Stratton-Europe-Captital/5-coding-r4.
No work package records a workingDirectory, repository-root assertion, LiteralPath/path allow-list check or no-Azure-command guard.
findings.impact: Commands can fail, validate a similarly named path or produce misleading evidence when invoked from another directory.
findings.remediation: Bind each command to cases/Stratton-Europe-Captital/5-coding-r4 (or use explicit repository-root paths), assert the resolved path remains inside that package, use literal paths, and record that local validation performs no Azure sign-in, what-if or deployment.

crossReviewCorroboration.finding: Audit-evidence custody and tamper protection are not bound.
crossReviewCorroboration.independentEvidence: A candidate-wide case-insensitive search found no audit-custody, WORM, evidence-envelope, co-retention, independent writer/reader or immutable-store contract. Work packages name evidence outputs without custody metadata or verification authority.
crossReviewCorroboration.remediation: Bind immutable evidence envelopes containing subject, command, runtime/tool, input/output hashes, signer, timestamp, owner and disposition; separate write/read authority and block promotion without custody verification.

crossReviewCorroboration.finding: Rollback text permits destructive deletion or mutation without an execution boundary.
crossReviewCorroboration.independentEvidence: MP-01 says remove evidence outputs; MP-02 and MP-03 say restore prior IaC/parameter bytes; MP-04, MP-06 and MP-08 also say remove or restore changes. The candidate does not require a human execution authorisation, exact path/hash allow-list or immutable evidence preservation.
crossReviewCorroboration.remediation: Use stop/disable and append-only forward correction. Preserve prior bytes and evidence; require separately authorised Phase 7 execution bound to exact paths, hashes, identity and abort conditions for any destructive cleanup.

verdictRationale: Five open MAJOR findings make the Phase 4 candidate materially weaker than the approved Phase 3 contract and non-conforming to the AFF manifest schema. Passing author contract tests do not close these omissions.
residualGaps: Owner-supplied Azure region, resource, quota, capacity, deployment and recovery evidence remains unresolved and fail closed.
Provider-use, privacy, source-use and EU AI Act evidence remains unresolved and must be approved by the accountable owner groups.
No benchmark, security-gate, route-parity, deployment, runtime or operating-effectiveness result is established.
requiredAction: Do not approve, promote, deploy or present this subject as complete. Preserve these exact seven candidate bytes and create a new append-only Phase 4 CC-002 remediation candidate correcting all findings; then obtain fresh AFF-A and AFF-B reviews against the unchanged new manifest.
nonDeploymentStatement: AFF-A does not approve, waive, certify, authorise Azure sign-in, what-if, deployment, route promotion, production inference, destructive rollback, Phase 7 or runtime testing.
